quotes.speaker: Kam Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Kam Jones on the uncertainty surrounding his trade to Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: there was a week, probably eight, nine days of just uncertainty. I had no idea what was going on
quotes.quote: There was a week, probably eight, nine days of just uncertainty. I had no idea what was going on, honestly. I just knew I got traded to Chicago. Didn't really hear much after that, so I was trying to figure out a way to keep getting better. Me and my boy Cheese were working out in the YMCA, just trying to find a court, trying to find a rim to get better on and playing outside. It was an interesting space for me, but I think it was good. It was positive for me mentally. I was able to have a lot of mental time with myself, and I'm grateful for that.
quotes.social_post: Kam Jones opens up about the uncertainty of his recent trade journey, revealing he spent time working out at a YMCA while waiting for clarity on his future. He says the experience was good for him mentally.

quotes.speaker: Kam Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Kam Jones on competing against veteran guards in practice
quotes.excerpt: It's been a lot of fun, just going against those guys, competing, seeing where you stand
quotes.quote: It's been a lot of fun, just going against those guys, competing, seeing where you stand and going at it, just attacking it. That's been my mindset. Even when you're uncertain, which a lot of this, being in the NBA, being a professional athlete, it's a lot of uncertainty. So every opportunity you get, you just want to attack it with everything you got. I like to lay my head on a pillow knowing I gave it everything I got, I controlled everything I could, and those are the results I can live with.
quotes.social_post: Kam Jones on the mindset of an NBA rookie: You have to attack every opportunity with everything you have so you can sleep at night knowing you controlled what you could.

quotes.speaker: Kam Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Kam Jones on the importance of team chemistry and trust
quotes.excerpt: We need to be a team that have each other's back and plays for one another
quotes.quote: The main thing we just need to be together. We need to compete, just be there for each other. We need to be a team that have each other's back and plays for one another, compete together, get better. That's what Coach Taylor, that's what he goes by, and I think it's great. It kind of reminds me of Coach Smart.
quotes.social_post: Kam Jones says the Bucks team culture under Coach Taylor reminds him of his time playing for Shaka Smart, emphasizing the need to compete and have each other's backs.

quotes.speaker: Kam Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Kam Jones on the influence of Coach Doc Rivers
quotes.excerpt: Shaka has quoted those words to me plenty of times in my college career
quotes.quote: It was kind of funny to me hearing some of the things he says. Doc has quoted those words to me plenty of times in my college career, so that gave me a lot of optimism and a lot of excitement to be with a coach like that.
quotes.social_post: Kam Jones says he feels a sense of optimism playing for Doc Rivers, noting that the coach has already used familiar words and philosophies that Jones heard throughout his college career.

quotes.speaker: Kam Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Kam Jones on the value of off-court team bonding
quotes.excerpt: As important as time on the court with each other is, that time off the court is just as important
quotes.quote: As important as time on the court with each other is, that time off the court is just as important, getting that connectivity and that trust and building those relationships and getting to know each other as people. So we know the guy who we're playing with, the guy to our left, the guy to our right. That makes you go that extra mile when your body don't feel like it, and that makes you have your teammate back even more, knowing that this is my brother and we're connecting and he has my back.
quotes.social_post: Kam Jones stresses that off-court bonding is just as important as practice time, noting that building trust as people makes players willing to go the extra mile for their teammates.

quotes.speaker: Kam Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Kam Jones on the veteran leadership of the Bucks
quotes.excerpt: MT has been great, Verd has been great, all our older guys, Koo, they've been great
quotes.quote: MT has been great, Verd has been great, all our older guys, Koo, they've been great and they've been real accepting, especially to me, making me feel welcome. So is Coach Doc Rivers, and I'm very appreciative of that.
quotes.social_post: Kam Jones credits the Bucks veteran leadership for making him feel welcome, specifically shouting out MT, Verd, and Koo for their acceptance of him as a new player.

quotes.speaker: Kam Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Kam Jones on the impact of Doc Rivers' competitive expectations
quotes.excerpt: Me and Cormac are very, very fierce competitors anyway, so we were going to do that in the first place
quotes.quote: It just gives you a lot of optimism. Me and Cormac are very, very fierce competitors anyway, so we were going to do that in the first place, but to just hear those words, it just gives you more hope and it makes you feel that much better.
quotes.social_post: Kam Jones says he and Cormac Ryan are fierce competitors by nature, but hearing Doc Rivers' expectations for the team gives them even more hope and confidence.

quotes.speaker: Kam Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Kam Jones on his defensive focus and role
quotes.excerpt: Defense is by far the most important with my situation and where I am
quotes.quote: I think it fits very well. I can be a good plug and play guy, handle the ball, play off the ball, play defense, which I think defense is going to be my biggest advantage. I need to every possession give everything I have on defense and do what the coaches ask me on offense, control the controllable, but defense is by far the most important with my situation and where I am and compete.
quotes.social_post: Kam Jones sees his defensive intensity as his biggest advantage in the Bucks rotation. He says he plans to be a plug and play guy who gives everything on every defensive possession.
